title: Mob Roulette
description: Every mob drops are random!. Unique randomization for every world.
body:
# Mob Roulette

Every world gets its own unique mob loot randomization.

When you create a new world, every eligible mob is assigned another mob's loot table. Once generated, the assignments never change for that world, even after restarting Minecraft or reopening the save.

That means:

Zombies might drop Blaze Rods.
Creepers might drop Diamonds.
Cows could drop Ender Pearls.
Skeletons could drop Rotten Flesh.

Every world is different, but each world's loot mapping stays permanent.

Features
🎲 Randomizes mob loot tables.
🌍 Every world has a unique random loot mapping.
💾 Loot mappings are permanently saved per world.
⚖️ Uses balanced loot pools for better survival progression.
🧟 Bosses have their own randomized boss loot pool.
📦 Works automatically in both singleplayer and multiplayer.

## Loot Categories:
### Common Mobs

Most overworld and Nether mobs share one randomized loot pool.

### Uncommon Mobs

Biome-specific and rarer mobs share a separate randomized loot pool.

### Bosses

Bosses only swap loot with other bosses.

### Shulkers

Shulkers always keep their original drops.
